_comment: Fixtures for scripts/eval-reservations.js — the phase 3 gate in docs/LIFE_ORG.md.
These are SYNTHETIC. They are written to look like the real thing (HTML-ish
boilerplate, fare rules between the outbound and return legs, marketing
footers) but they are not real vendor mail, so a good score here is a floor
and not the gate. The gate is 20 real confirmations across 6+ vendors, run
with `--store` against a COPY of a real mailbox.
`expect` uses null to mean 'must come back null' — that scores hallucination,
not just misses. Omit a field entirely to skip scoring it.
`today` pins the clock so relative-date and missing-year cases are stable.

cases.note: The return leg sits after a wall of fare rules — the case that motivated an 8000-char body slice.
